👋 Meet the Author

Aaron Reynolds

Have you ever read a book that was funny and spooky at the same time? Aaron Reynolds is the author who created all of Jasper Rabbit's creepy adventures!

On this adventure, you'll meet the author, explore three creepy books, investigate Jasper Rabbit's mysterious problems, and even invent your very own creepy story!

Look closely: the same rabbit appears again and again — but each ordinary object brings a brand-new problem.
